dedupe_keys.name: sgu mineral permits and exploration permits mineral register extract sweden

description: A national map dataset of Swedish mining concessions and exploration permits. The SGU page says the product is an extract of the Mineral Register kept by the Mining Inspectorate, with exploitation concessions and exploration permits, each with its identity, name, holder and period of validity, and that it is available as open data. It can be downloaded free as a zipped GeoPackage, queried through an OGC API Features service returning GeoJSON and displayed through a WMS, and the page was last reviewed on 22 January 2025. Coverage is Sweden. Licence (read on the provider page on 2026-09-28): CC0-1.0 (SGU licence terms for open geological data). For simulation it shows where mines and exploration may open or expand, for planning power, rail and road links to mining regions and for assessing concentration of mineral supply. A related catalogue record is the WRI mining concessions dataset. The underlying files were not downloaded, so their contents are not verified here.
